title: record:path: a record in a lost state should show the path stopped at the open step it left, which needs the stage the record came from (split from #26612)
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui#4` seat (`session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T`). It carries the one target of #26612 that PR #26689 could not build (os-dev report 6442371590, open question). It is not a claim and carries no labels; it is left for triage.

## Wanted (from #26612 target 1)

A record in a lost state shows the stage path stopped at its last open step, with the lost chip apart.

## Measured

PR #26689 lays the path out by the option's declared `kind`: open steps, then the won terminus, with lost apart. A lost record shows the lost stage current with ✗, and the forward steps untravelled. The renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`) reads only the current record row (`RecordContextValue`). The row carries the current value, not the open step it left, so "the last open step" is not knowable from what the renderer holds.

## Related

#26581 (record:path draws skipped stages as passed) is waiting on a maintainer ruling. Its option B is the same mechanism this card needs, a stage-history read (`sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity`), and its decision comment lists why that history is incomplete. Rule the two together.
